from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,sys
old=Path('/srv/pink-iptv-device-proof')
target=Path('/srv/pink-iptv')/'tests'/'device-proof'
print('===PINK_PROOFS_PREFLIGHT===')
for x in [old,old.parent,target,target.parent]:
 print('PATH',str(x),'exists',x.exists(),'symlink',x.is_symlink(),'mount_dev',x.stat().st_dev if x.exists() else 'none')
if old.is_dir():
 print('SOURCE_CHILDREN')
 for p in sorted(old.iterdir())[:75]:
  print('CHILD',p.name,'dir',p.is_dir(),'symlink',p.is_symlink())
for x in [Path('/srv/pink-iptv/.gitignore'),Path('/srv/pink-iptv/.git/info/exclude')]:
 if x.is_file():
  print('IGNORE_PATH',str(x))
  for l in x.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()[:65]:
   if 'test' in l.lower() or 'device' in l.lower() or 'proof' in l.lower() or 'artifact' in l.lower() or 'build' in l.lower():
    print('IGNORE_LINE',l[:140])
print('===PINK_PROCESS_CWD===')
for f in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not f.name.isdigit():continue
 try:
  cwd=os.readlink(f/'cwd')
  if '/srv/pink-iptv-device-proof' in cwd:print('CWD_REF',f.name,cwd)
 except OSError:pass
print('===PINK_PATH_REFERENCES===')
needle='/srv/pink-iptv-device-proof'
roots=['/srv/pink-iptv','/etc/systemd/system','/etc/cron.d','/usr/local/sbin','/home/ubuntu/codex-bridge','/root/.pm2']
for root in roots:
 base=Path(root)
 if not base.is_dir():continue
 found=0; visited=0
 for folder,dirs,files in os.walk(root):
  depth=len(Path(folder).parts)-len(base.parts)
  if depth>=5:dirs.clear()
  dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d not in ('.git','.venv','node_modules','build','.gradle','.cache','releases','jobs','dist') and not d.startswith('.')]
  for name in files:
   p=Path(folder)/name
   try:
    if p.is_symlink() or p.stat().st_size>300000:continue
    if p.suffix not in ('.py','.sh','.md','.yaml','.yml','.json','.js','.service','.conf','.timer','.txt','.xml','.gradle','.properties'):continue
    visited+=1
    if needle in p.read_text(errors='replace'):
     print('REFERENCE',str(p))
     found+=1
   except (OSError,UnicodeError):pass
 print('SCAN',root,'visited',visited,'matching',found)
print('===PINK_GIT_REVIEW===')
p=subprocess.run(['git','-C','/srv/pink-iptv','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=13)
print('GIT_EXIT',p.returncode,'TRACKED_CHANGES',len(p.stdout.splitlines()))
print('===PINK_SERVICE===')
p=subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active','pink-iptv-backend.service'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
print('BACKEND',p.stdout.strip())
print('===PREFLIGHT_END===')
